tokens.name: surface-white
tokens.usage: Full-width content bands (home product and brand sections, the main area of sign-up, routine and subscription pages), result boxes, inputs.

tokens.name: surface-footer
tokens.usage: Common footer band only.

tokens.name: surface-photo
tokens.usage: Image slots and photo backgrounds; matches the bright white/grey product-photo direction.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, product names, prices, body text on any surface (15.6:1 on surface-page).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Supporting text: ingredients, captions, labels, footnotes (6.1:1 on surface-page, 5.5:1 on surface-photo).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers, the rule after section titles, header and footer borders, tag outlines.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Edge of a white band against surface-page.

tokens.name: line-input
tokens.usage: Input, chip and quantity-stepper borders; dashed rules marking undecided content.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The one accent. Primary and key-action button fills, text links, selected chips, menu hover underline, focus ring. Never on banners, badges or headlines. White text on it 4.9:1.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for every button (primary, secondary, key action).

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill.

tokens.name: on-brand-hover
tokens.usage: Text on brand-hover (5.8:1).

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: The darkest brand green: the footer wordmark only (10.4:1 on surface-footer).

families.sans: Pretendard, "Pretendard Variable", "IBM Plex Sans KR", "Noto Sans KR", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: wordmark-footer
styles.usage: Footer brand name only, in brand-deep, centred on one line. Fluid: font-size calc((100cqw - 160px) / 6.2) on a footer with container-type: inline-size, so it fills the footer with 80px (space-20) clear on each side; 207px at a 1440 frame. One of the two large expressions on a page.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: Home first-screen title, two lines. The page's one large headline.
